description: This file is a Perl module defining the Error package, which provides object-oriented error and exception handling functionalities including error creation, throwing, catching, and stack tracing. It includes multiple classes such as Error, Error::Simple, Error::subs, and Error::WarnDie, along with their associated methods and overloads. The module also offers syntactic sugar for exception handling, integrates with Perl's warnings and die signals, and contains documentation and examples for usage.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Primary class for errors and exceptions providing creation, propagation, and introspection of error objects, including stack trace management and object association.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: A subclass of Error representing simple textual errors with optional associated values, used internally for string-based errors.

classes.name: Error::subs
classes.description: Provides syntactic sugar for exception handling constructs such as try, catch, finally, except, otherwise, supporting structured error management in Perl code.

classes.name: Error::WarnDie
classes.description: A package that overrides Perl's warning and die signals to generate detailed stack traces and handle errors using the Error module's infrastructure.

methods.name: prior
methods.description: Returns the last created error or the last error associated with a specified package.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears the last error or associated error in a package.

methods.name: stacktrace
methods.description: Returns the stack trace for an error if $Error::Debug was set during error creation.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Associates an error object with an arbitrary object, enabling error propagation and context linking.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Error or subclass object, recording contextual information such as file, line, and optional associated object.

methods.name: throw
methods.description: Throws the Error object, resulting in an exception that can be caught via eval or try blocks.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a new Error object with specified parameters, used for syntactic sugar.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a new Error object and returns it, for explicit error logging.
